title: The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass
shortDescription: A touch-led adventure that turns map notes, stylus gestures, and compact sailing routes into direct puzzle-solving tools.
highlights: Writing on maps makes player observations part of the solution
Touch interactions give familiar adventure tools a playful new rhythm
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A Nintendo DS adventure pick that makes unusually good use of the system's defining input methods.
